title.zh: 比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型
title.en: Alameda-Backed Bitcoin Miner Genesis Digital Raises About $900 Million for AI Da

current_state.zh: SWI Group 以61亿欧元估值完成8亿欧元（约8.94亿美元）融资，用于将已更名并控股70%投票权的SWI Digital（原Genesis Digital Assets）在美国和瑞典的比特币矿场改造为AI数据中心，同时出售哈萨克斯坦矿场资产。
current_state.en: SWI Group completed an €800 million (~$894 million) fundraise at a €6.1 billion valuation to convert the now-majority-controlled and renamed SWI Digital (formerly Genesis Digital Assets) bitcoin mining sites in the U.S. and Sweden into AI data centers, while selling Kazakhstan mining assets.

updates.title_zh: Alameda支持的比特币矿企Genesis Digital为AI数据业务融资约9亿美元
updates.title_en: Alameda-Backed Bitcoin Miner Genesis Digital Raises About $900 Million for AI Da
updates.what_changed_zh: SWI Group 宣布融资约 9 亿美元（8 亿欧元），用于将 Alameda 支持的比特币矿企 Genesis Digital Assets 转型为服务大型云厂商的 AI 数据中心业务，利用其美国和瑞典站点，同时出售哈萨克斯坦的挖矿资产。
updates.what_changed_en: SWI Group announced it is raising about $900 million (€800 million) to fund the conversion of Alameda-backed bitcoin miner Genesis Digital Assets into an AI data center business serving large cloud providers, using its U.S. and Swedish sites while selling off Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.current_state_zh: SWI Group 宣布融资约 9 亿美元（8 亿欧元），用于将 Alameda 支持的比特币矿企 Genesis Digital Assets 转型为服务大型云厂商的 AI 数据中心业务，利用其美国和瑞典站点，同时出售哈萨克斯坦的挖矿资产。
updates.current_state_en: SWI Group announced it is raising about $900 million (€800 million) to fund the conversion of Alameda-backed bitcoin miner Genesis Digital Assets into an AI data center business serving large cloud providers, using its U.S. and Swedish sites while selling off Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SWI Group announced it is raising about $900 million (€800 million) to fund the conversion of Alameda-backed bitcoin miner Genesis Digital Assets into an AI data center business serving large cloud providers, using its U.S. and Swedish sites while selling off Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SWI Group announced it is raising about $900 million (€800 million) to fund the conversion of Alameda-backed bitcoin miner Genesis Digital Assets into an AI data center business serving large cloud providers, using its U.S. and Swedish sites while selling off Kazakhstan mining assets.

updates.title_zh: 比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型
updates.title_en: 比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型
updates.what_changed_zh: SWI Group 于2026年6月以5亿美元收购Genesis Digital Assets大量股权并成为控股股东；计划利用其在美国得克萨斯州、南北卡罗来纳州及瑞典的数据中心为大型云计算服务商提供算力；并出售剩余的哈萨克斯坦矿场资产。
updates.what_changed_en: SWI Group acquired a majority stake in Genesis Digital Assets for $500 million in June 2026 and became controlling shareholder; plans to use its data centers in Texas, North and South Carolina, and Sweden to provide computing power to large cloud providers; and sell remaining Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.current_state_zh: SWI Group 在2026年6月以5亿美元收购Genesis Digital Assets控股权后，于10月12日宣布融资8亿欧元（约9亿美元），用于将Genesis Digital Assets在美国得克萨斯州、南北卡罗来纳州及瑞典的比特币矿场改造为服务大型云计算商的AI数据中心，并出售剩余的哈萨克斯坦矿场资产。
updates.current_state_en: After acquiring a controlling stake in Genesis Digital Assets for $500 million in June 2026, SWI Group announced on October 12 €800 million (~$900 million) in financing to convert Genesis Digital Assets' bitcoin mining sites in Texas, North and South Carolina, and Sweden into AI data centers serving large cloud providers, while divesting remaining Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Genesis Digital Assets, now controlled by SWI Group, announced €800M (~US$900M) in financing to convert its US and Swedish bitcoin mining sites into AI data centers serving large cloud providers while divesting its Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Genesis Digital Assets, now controlled by SWI Group, announced €800M (~US$900M) in financing to convert its US and Swedish bitcoin mining sites into AI data centers serving large cloud providers while divesting its Kazakhstan mining assets.

updates.title_zh: SWI融资8.94亿美元，将前FTX比特币矿企Genesis Digital转型为AI业务
updates.title_en: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充：SWI Group 以61亿欧元估值从机构投资者处融资8亿欧元（约8.94亿美元）；2026年6月以5亿美元收购Genesis Digital Assets约40%股权，8月完成交易并持有70%投票权，将其更名为SWI Digital；CEO表示对比特币挖矿“零兴趣”。
updates.what_changed_en: New report adds: SWI Group raised €800 million (~$894 million) from institutional investors at a €6.1 billion valuation; it bought about 40% of Genesis Digital Assets for $500 million in June 2026, completed the deal in August with 70% voting rights, and renamed the unit SWI Digital; CEO said he has "zero interest" in bitcoin mining.
updates.current_state_zh: SWI Group 以61亿欧元估值完成8亿欧元（约8.94亿美元）融资，用于将已更名并控股70%投票权的SWI Digital（原Genesis Digital Assets）在美国和瑞典的比特币矿场改造为AI数据中心，同时出售哈萨克斯坦矿场资产。
updates.current_state_en: SWI Group completed an €800 million (~$894 million) fundraise at a €6.1 billion valuation to convert the now-majority-controlled and renamed SWI Digital (formerly Genesis Digital Assets) bitcoin mining sites in the U.S. and Sweden into AI data centers, while selling Kazakhstan mining assets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SWI Group raised €800 million ($894 million) from institutional investors at a €6.1 billion valuation to convert the ex-FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital Assets into an AI-focused data center operator in Europe and the U.S.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SWI Group raised €800 million ($894 million) from institutional investors at a €6.1 billion valuation to convert the ex-FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital Assets into an AI-focused data center operator in Europe and the U.S.
